caption: Connecting roads to unreached roads
content: Unreached outside roads are marked with @i{road_locker}.
You can progress when they are connected to a @b{reached} @b{outside} road.

content.caption: Failed examples
content: e.g. 1: Unreached roads are connected to each other. Either must be reached first.
e.g. 2: An unreached road is connected to inside road. The starting road must be outside.
